role: Adaptive development-only coverage repair, separate from the original46 HPO attempts.
reason: All four executed trials for each linear/kernel family used native preparation; random sampling did not exercise log_clip. Testing a declared search option requires actual measurements rather than assuming coverage.
control: For each family retain the best completed original CV configuration, including features, start year, recency weights and estimator parameters. Change only preparation from native to log_clip; evaluate both identical earlier folds with the same60000/20000caps. No benchmark use.
promotion: Promote the better mean-CV-AP option within each family to the existing Q3 candidate slot; retain both results. A failed supplemental fit remains recorded and cannot replace a valid candidate. No additional Q3 candidate slots or blend weights.
interpretation: This adds adaptive development comparisons and does not restore independent evaluation. A difference measures the combined clipping/logarithmic preparation pipeline, not each mathematical operation separately.
